name: ac-alternatives-and-real-assets
description: Evaluating alternative and real-asset exposures: real-estate vehicles and their NAV arithmetic, commodity exposure and roll mechanics, gold as an asset, collectibles and their opacity, infrastructure and private assets with their lockups, the role alternatives play in a portfolio, and the liquidity premium that pays for illiquidity until it does not. It evaluates exposures and states confidence; it never recommends an asset or predicts returns. Use when asking "REITs", "commodities", "gold as a hedge", "collectibles as an investment", "private assets", "liquidity premium", "alternatives allocation". Not for public equity research (ac-equity-research), not for valuation of a business (ac-valuation), not for policy allocation (ac-investment-policy-statement).
